title: modern scope panels, compact density token, compact segmented controls

commit.merge_subject: merge: modern scope panels, compact density token, compact segmented controls

description:
With Settings > Preview stats readback off, the GPU preview publishes a
1x1 placeholder frame, so the scopes used to draw a histogram of one
black pixel and an empty waveform. The strip and mini now detect the
placeholder (PreviewSurfaceRatio.carriesShape) and show the graticule
with a hint pointing at the setting, never a fabricated trace.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
changed: ui: compact density token for high-dpi phones
ui: compact segmented controls in editor panels
ui: scope empty-state hint when preview stats are off
